global.title: IP law has a space problem
global.summary: Falling launch costs and rising launch cadence have turned a once-fanciful idea into a live commercial proposal: data centers in orbit. Several companies have floated space-based facilities that would run AI workloads using space’s free solar power and radiative cooling, without the land-use fights that increasingly slow terrestrial data center construction.
